exposure: care received during hospitalization for birth
outcome: incidence of exclusive breastfeeding in the sixth month of life
cohort: The study included 291 pregnant women/puerperal women from two hospitals in Guarapuava, Parana, Brazil.
finding: The absence of formula supplementation, proper guidance on breastfeeding techniques, and timely initiation of breastfeeding during hospitalization were significantly associated with the duration and incidence of exclusive breastfeeding.
